description: P36 (plan M6-M9 §5.7 side quests, §5.9, §5.10): the toll-riders' siege line - hired by Aldmere - bombards Skarn's longhouses (event.siege_of_skarn). It starts with Ulfra's plea (stage 5) or when the siege begins (a stage-6 giant arriving at Skarn); until the siege begins its first stage sends the giant to Skarn's green, where the line sets up (M8 gate: a waiting text when the siege cannot start yet). Break the line's five engines (siege disruption at stage 6 is the intended way; blows break them too) before two longhouses burn: saved - 300 XP, 1 titan iron, Skarn's support (Harrok's talk ending) and its hearth-forge. If Skarn burns the quest is lost (abandoned) and quest.skarn_rebuild raises the halls again. The line holds its fire while the giant is more than 200 m from Skarn.

stages.objective: Stand on Skarn's green: the toll-riders' siege line sets up when you are there
stages.waiting_text: The toll-riders' siege line waits east of the steading for you: it sets up its engines once you stand on Skarn's green, and not while you are away.

stages.objective: Break the siege line before Skarn's longhouses burn
stages.waiting_text: The siege line stands east of Skarn: three catapults and two ballistae with their crews, pikes, shields and cavalry. Break the engines before two longhouses fall. Their fire stops while you are far away.
